name: Brain Training 3D
description:
Distribution of this software ended at 10:00 on Wednesday, June 30, 2021.

----------------------------------------------
``3D Brain Training'' is a new type of training that trains your brain and develops ``memorization'' and ``ability to think'' in space. Develop your memory and thinking skills by capturing images and concepts of objects in space. You will train your brain by ``remembering'', ``searching'', and ``thinking'' while having fun with training that feels like a shooting game.
disclaimer:
The contents of the software are the same as the package version released on April 7, 2011 (price: 4,104 yen).
Due to the large amount of data, it may take a long time to download the software. Please download while charging your Nintendo 3DS.
